description:
Create, list and show thread files at threads/<Kind>/<Name>.md, where Kind is Projects, Processes or Topics.

Subcommands:
  list [QUERY] [--all] [--json] — list threads; open only by default
  show THREAD [--json] — show one thread file
  new --name NAME --kind KIND --category CATEGORY [--currency CODE] [--rate N] — create a thread file

Flags:
  list:
    QUERY  optional fuzzy search; results ranked by similarity
    --all  include paused and closed threads
    --json  JSON output
  show:
    THREAD  thread name or 'Kind/Name'
    --json  JSON output
  new:
    --name NAME  required; becomes the filename; no '/', no leading '.'
    --kind  required; project, process or topic (filed under Projects, Processes, Topics)
    --category  required; professional, personal or voluntary
    --currency CODE  3-letter ISO code; default currency for hours; makes the thread billable
    --rate N  default hourly rate for hours; needs --currency

Examples:
  ["list", "--all", "--json"]
  ["show", "Projects/SGB"]
  ["new", "--name", "SGB", "--kind", "project", "--category", "professional", "--currency", "ZAR", "--rate", "1500"]
  ["new", "--name", "Fitness", "--kind", "topic", "--category", "personal"]

Notes:
  There is no close or delete subcommand. To close a thread, edit its frontmatter: status: closed and ended: YYYY-MM-DD. Removing a thread means deleting its file and folder by hand; do not do this unless asked.
  Exit 1: thread already exists, empty name, name containing '/' or starting with '.', --rate without --currency.
